column1: # OWASP ZAP rule configuration for the LP + CRM API (docs: https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/docker/api-scan/).
# Format: <rule id> TAB <WARN|IGNORE|FAIL> TAB (<rule name>) [TAB <comment>]. Rules not listed stay WARN.
# The run is PASSIVE ONLY (see security/zap/README.md); the Medium/High gate lives in check-report.mjs.
# Policy: IGNORE only a proven false positive for a JSON-only API, each with its justification below.
# FAIL marks regression guards for baseline headers/behaviours that 000-overview §5.1 makes mandatory:
# if one of these ever shows up, the pipeline must go red regardless of the alert's risk level.
# --- Regression guards (FAIL): mandatory response headers (000-overview §5.1, AC-LC-16) ----------

column4: X-Frame-Options: DENY and CSP frame-ancestors are set on every response
nosniff is set on every response, including errors and preflight
HSTS is set on every response; only meaningful when the target is https
CSP default-src 'none' is set on every response
Permissions-Policy is set on every response

column1: # --- Regression guards (FAIL): the API must never leak internals or set cookies -----------------

column4: no version in Server; Vercel sends a bare product token
the API is stateless and never sets cookies; any cookie is a regression
errors are RFC 9457 problem+json with no stack/driver text (AC-LC-18)
no token or PII in query strings
CORS is an explicit allowlist, never *

column1: # --- Known false positives for a JSON-only API (IGNORE, justified) ------------------------------

column4: Informational: reports missing Sec-Fetch-* REQUEST headers, which a browser sends and ZAP's HTTP client does not. Not a property of the API.
Informational heuristic for HTML single-page apps; this origin serves only JSON (no HTML, no scripts).

column1: # --- Triage candidates for the first Onda 6b run (left at WARN on purpose) -----------------------
# 10055 (CSP) may report directives without fallback on our minimal CSP; decide in 6b whether it is a real
#       finding for a non-HTML API or a false positive worth an IGNORE with the evidence attached.
# 10062 (PII Disclosure, High) is pattern based (card-like digit runs); a UUID in a 202 body can match by
#       chance. Only IGNORE it in 6b with the offending response attached as evidence.
# 90004 (Spectre site isolation, Low): CORP same-site is set; COOP/COEP are irrelevant to JSON responses.
# 10049 (Content Cacheability): Cache-Control: no-store is set; "Non-Storable Content" is Informational.
